name: Windows Desktop & Shell
layout_summary: Desktop surface with shortcut icons. Bottom taskbar: centered or left-aligned Start button (Windows logo), Search box/icon, Task View, pinned/running app icons, and bottom-right System Tray (hidden icons chevron, Wi-Fi/Network, Volume speaker, Battery, Clock/Notifications).
avoid_traps: Prefer open_app(name) or press_key('win+s') over hunting for small desktop shortcut icons.
Use win+a to open Quick Settings (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Volume, Brightness) directly rather than clicking tiny system tray icons.

start_menu.visual_fallback: smart_click('Start Windows logo button on taskbar')

windows_search.verify: Windows Search flyout opens with search input focused

quick_settings_volume_wifi.visual_fallback: smart_click('Wi-Fi and Volume icons at bottom-right system tray')
quick_settings_volume_wifi.verify: Quick Settings flyout (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Volume slider) opens at bottom-right

open_file_explorer.visual_fallback: smart_click('File Explorer yellow folder icon on taskbar')
open_file_explorer.verify: A new Windows File Explorer window opens

show_desktop.verify: All open windows minimize to reveal the desktop

run_dialog.verify: Windows Run dialog box opens at bottom-left

switch_window.verify: Switches focus to the previous active window
